title: Tuckman's Model of Team Development
stages: [{"name":"Forming","desc":"The team orients to the work and looks to the leader for structure. Goals, roles, and working agreements need to be made explicit before momentum builds."},{"name":"Storming","desc":"Different expectations and working styles surface. Productive conflict is normal here; the job is to make tension discussable and turn it into decisions."},{"name":"Norming","desc":"Trust, routines, and shared standards begin to settle.
